title: 高層建築斜交網格結構
summary: 以紐約赫斯特大樓、倫敦聖瑪莉艾克斯 30 號與廣州國際金融中心為例，從斜柱角度如何在剪力與彎曲勁度之間取捨、樓板如何以環向拉力平衡斜柱外推力出發，處理螺栓與焊接節點、鋼管混凝土斜柱，再到斜柱逐層安裝的穩定與測量控制、節點原型試驗、以實測週期驗證勁度，最後是外露斜柱的耐火防蝕與改裝管控。
summaryEn: Using the Hearst Tower in New York, 30 St Mary Axe in London and the Guangzhou International Finance Center as examples, start from how the diagonal angle trades shear against bending stiffness and how floors balance the diagonals' outward thrust with hoop tension, handle bolted and welded nodes and concrete-filled tube diagonals, then the stability and survey control of erecting inclined members, node prototype tests and stiffness verification from measured periods, ending with fire and corrosion upkeep of exposed diagonals and control of alterations.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 斜交網格初步選角練習：某高 180 m、平面 36 m 見方的辦公塔，以 4 層一組的斜交網格抵抗側力，每個面有 n = 6 根斜柱，設計基底剪力 V = 10 MN、均布風載下基底彎矩 M = V·H/2 = 10×180/2 = 900 MN·m。剪力由兩個腹面承擔：斜柱軸力 N_s = V/(2n·cosθ)；彎矩由翼面以力偶承擔：翼面合力 F = M/B = 900/36 = 25 MN，每根斜柱垂直分量 25/6 ≈ 4.17 MN，軸力 N_b = 4.17/sinθ。θ = 69° 時 N_s ≈ 10/(12×0.358) ≈ 2.33 MN、N_b ≈ 4.46 MN；θ = 60° 時 N_s ≈ 1.67 MN、N_b ≈ 4.81 MN。以容許應力 207 MPa 估算，69° 時彎曲控制的斜柱需約 21,600 mm²、剪力只需約 11,200 mm²；改為 60° 時彎曲需求增加約 8% 至約 23,200 mm²，剪力需求降為約 8,100 mm²。細長塔由彎曲控制，因此較陡的角度通常較省鋼；若建築改為更矮胖的比例，剪力比重上升，最佳角度就會變平。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際建築的設計。
workedExample.textEn: Preliminary diagrid angle study: a 180 m office tower, 36 m square, resists lateral load with a four-storey diagrid of n = 6 diagonals per face; the design base shear is V = 10 MN and under uniform wind the base moment is M = V·H/2 = 10×180/2 = 900 MN·m. Shear is carried by the two web faces, giving diagonal force N_s = V/(2n·cosθ); the moment is carried as a couple by the flange faces, with a flange resultant F = M/B = 900/36 = 25 MN, a vertical component of 25/6 ≈ 4.17 MN per diagonal and axial force N_b = 4.17/sinθ. At θ = 69°, N_s ≈ 10/(12×0.358) ≈ 2.33 MN and N_b ≈ 4.46 MN; at θ = 60°, N_s ≈ 1.67 MN and N_b ≈ 4.81 MN. At an allowable stress of 207 MPa, the bending-governed diagonal at 69° needs about 21,600 mm² while shear needs only about 11,200 mm²; at 60° the bending demand rises about 8% to about 23,200 mm² and the shear demand falls to about 8,100 mm². A slender tower is governed by bending, so steeper angles usually save steel; a squatter building, with shear more important, would favour a flatter optimum. Values are teaching assumptions, not the design of any real building.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「斜交網格的軸力傳力與角度取捨」與「斜柱外推力與樓板環向拉力」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Axial load paths and the angle trade-off" and "Diagonal outward thrust and floor hoop tension": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 斜交網格的軸力傳力與角度取捨：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Axial load paths and the angle trade-off: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「斜柱角度」如何影響高層建築斜交網格結構的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Diagonal angle” governs force, deformation or durability in “High-rise diagrid structures”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 斜交網格以外圍的斜柱同時承擔重力與側力，構件主要受軸力而非彎矩，因此用鋼量比一般的柱梁構架少；公開資料指出赫斯特大樓的斜交網格比同規模的傳統設計少用約兩成鋼材。斜柱的角度決定它對兩種勁度的貢獻：抵抗剪力時，較平的斜柱水平分量大；抵抗整體彎曲（傾覆）時，較陡的斜柱垂直分量大。高樓越細長，彎曲越主導，最佳角度就越陡，實務上多落在約 60° 到 75° 之間。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「斜柱角度」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A diagrid carries gravity and lateral load through perimeter diagonals that act mainly in axial force rather than bending, so it uses less steel than a conventional column-and-beam frame; public sources state that the Hearst Tower diagrid used about 20% less steel than a comparable conventional design. The diagonal angle sets the contribution to two kinds of stiffness: flatter diagonals have more horizontal component to resist shear, while steeper ones have more vertical component to resist overall bending, or overturning. The more slender the tower, the more bending governs and the steeper the optimum angle, typically between about 60° and 75° in practice. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Diagonal angle” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：單根斜柱在模組高 h 內的勁度：剪力方向 k_h = (EA/h)·sinθ·cos²θ，彎曲（垂直）方向 k_v = (EA/h)·sin³θ。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Stiffness of one diagonal over a module height h: in shear k_h = (EA/h)·sinθ·cos²θ, and in bending (vertical) k_v = (EA/h)·sin³θ. sinθcos²θ peaks at θ ≈ 35.3° (0.385) and is 0.217 at 60° and 0.120 at 69°; sin³θ is 0.650 at 60°, 0.814 at 69° and 0.901 at 75°.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「斜交網格的角度只是建築造型的選擇，對結構效率沒有影響。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The diagrid angle is purely an aesthetic choice with no effect on structural efficiency." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「斜柱角度」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Diagonal angle”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 斜交網格的軸力傳力與角度取捨：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Axial load paths and the angle trade-off: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「斜柱角度」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Diagonal angle” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：單根斜柱在模組高 h 內的勁度：剪力方向 k_h = (EA/h)·sinθ·cos²θ，彎曲（垂直）方向 k_v = (EA/h)·sin³θ。sinθcos²θ 在 θ ≈ 35.3° 時最大（0.385），θ = 60° 時 0.217、69° 時 0.120；sin³θ 在 60° 時 0.650、69° 時 0.814、75° 時 0.901。角度由 60° 變陡到 69°，彎曲勁度增加約 25%，剪力勁度卻減少約 45%。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Stiffness of one diagonal over a module height h: in shear k_h = (EA/h)·sinθ·cos²θ, and in bending (vertical) k_v = (EA/h)·sin³θ. sinθcos²θ peaks at θ ≈ 35.3° (0.385) and is 0.217 at 60° and 0.120 at 69°; sin³θ is 0.650 at 60°, 0.814 at 69° and 0.901 at 75°. Steepening from 60° to 69° raises bending stiffness by about 25% but cuts shear stiffness by about 45%. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以初步模型比較數種斜角與模組高度（例如 2、4、6 層一組）的頂部變位、用鋼量與節點數量，並分別輸出剪力變形與彎曲變形的比例，確認選定的角度讓兩者都在合理範圍；同時檢查角度是否與樓層高度、帷幕分割與節點製造相容。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare several angles and module heights, for example two, four or six storeys per module, in a preliminary model for top drift, steel tonnage and number of nodes, separating shear and bending deformation to confirm that the chosen angle keeps both reasonable; check also that the angle suits storey heights, façade panelling and node fabrication.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 斜交網格的軸力傳力與角度取捨：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Axial load paths and the angle trade-off: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「斜柱角度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Diagonal angle” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以初步模型比較數種斜角與模組高度（例如 2、4、6 層一組）的頂部變位、用鋼量與節點數量，並分別輸出剪力變形與彎曲變形的比例，確認選定的角度讓兩者都在合理範圍；同時檢查角度是否與樓層高度、帷幕分割與節點製造相容。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare several angles and module heights, for example two, four or six storeys per module, in a preliminary model for top drift, steel tonnage and number of nodes, separating shear and bending deformation to confirm that the chosen angle keeps both reasonable; check also that the angle suits storey heights, façade panelling and node fabrication. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：在設計基準書中記錄斜角與模組高度的比選過程與依據，並明列剪力與彎曲變形的分配；建築若要調整模組或斜角，須回到結構顧問重新評估用鋼量與勁度。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Record the angle and module-height comparison and its rationale in the design basis, stating the split between shear and bending deformation; any architectural change to module or angle must return to the structural consultant to reassess tonnage and stiffness.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若只追求最少鋼材而選擇過陡的斜柱，剪力勁度不足，樓層間會出現較大的剪切變形，帷幕與隔間受損；角度過平則傾覆勁度不足，頂部擺動與角落斜柱軸力都會偏大。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Choosing over-steep diagonals purely for minimum steel leaves too little shear stiffness, producing large inter-storey shear deformation that damages the façade and partitions; too flat an angle leaves too little overturning stiffness, increasing top sway and corner-diagonal forces. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.text: 以初步模型比較數種斜角與模組高度（例如 2、4、6 層一組）的頂部變位、用鋼量與節點數量，並分別輸出剪力變形與彎曲變形的比例，確認選定的角度讓兩者都在合理範圍；同時檢查角度是否與樓層高度、帷幕分割與節點製造相容。
knowledge.textEn: Compare several angles and module heights, for example two, four or six storeys per module, in a preliminary model for top drift, steel tonnage and number of nodes, separating shear and bending deformation to confirm that the chosen angle keeps both reasonable; check also that the angle suits storey heights, façade panelling and node fabrication.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 在設計基準書中記錄斜角與模組高度的比選過程與依據，並明列剪力與彎曲變形的分配；建築若要調整模組或斜角，須回到結構顧問重新評估用鋼量與勁度。

quiz.question: 要驗證「斜交網格的軸力傳力與角度取捨」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Axial load paths and the angle trade-off"?
options: 以初步模型比較數種斜角與模組高度（例如 2、4、6 層一組）的頂部變位、用鋼量與節點數量，並分別輸出剪力變形與彎曲變形的比例，確認選定的角度讓兩者都在合理範圍。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
週期量測只是學術研究，對結構驗收沒有意義。
optionsEn: Compare several angles and module heights, for example two, four or six storeys per module, in a preliminary model for top drift, steel tonnage and number of nodes, separating shear and bending deformation to confirm that the chosen angle keeps both reasonable.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Period measurement is merely academic and means nothing for structural acceptance.

quiz.explanationEn: Compare several angles and module heights, for example two, four or six storeys per module, in a preliminary model for top drift, steel tonnage and number of nodes, separating shear and bending deformation to confirm that the chosen angle keeps both reasonable; check also that the angle suits storey heights, façade panelling and node fabrication. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 斜交網格的軸力傳力與角度取捨：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Axial load paths and the angle trade-off: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「斜柱角度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Diagonal angle” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若只追求最少鋼材而選擇過陡的斜柱，剪力勁度不足，樓層間會出現較大的剪切變形，帷幕與隔間受損；角度過平則傾覆勁度不足，頂部擺動與角落斜柱軸力都會偏大。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Choosing over-steep diagonals purely for minimum steel leaves too little shear stiffness, producing large inter-storey shear deformation that damages the façade and partitions; too flat an angle leaves too little overturning stiffness, increasing top sway and corner-diagonal forces. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：高樓越細長，彎曲越主導，最佳角度就越陡，實務上多落在約 60° 到 75° 之間。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The more slender the tower, the more bending governs and the steeper the optimum angle, typically between about 60° and 75° in practice.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「斜交網格的角度只是建築造型的選擇，對結構效率沒有影響。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The diagrid angle is purely an aesthetic choice with no effect on structural efficiency." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

quiz.question: 在「斜交網格的軸力傳力與角度取捨」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Axial load paths and the angle trade-off" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若只追求最少鋼材而選擇過陡的斜柱，剪力勁度不足，樓層間會出現較大的剪切變形，帷幕與隔間受損；角度過平則傾覆勁度不足，頂部擺動與角落斜柱軸力都會偏大。
斜交網格的樓板只承受樓面載重，與斜柱的穩定無關。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Choosing over-steep diagonals purely for minimum steel leaves too little shear stiffness, producing large inter-storey shear deformation that damages the façade and partitions.
Floors in a diagrid only carry floor loads and have nothing to do with the diagonals' stability.

Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 斜柱外推力與樓板環向拉力：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Diagonal outward thrust and floor hoop tension: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「樓板環向繫材」如何影響高層建築斜交網格結構的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Floor hoop ties” governs force, deformation or durability in “High-rise diagrid structures”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 在斜交網格中，重力沿著傾斜的構件往下傳，兩根斜柱在節點相交時，垂直分量相加傳給下方，水平分量則把節點往外推。這個外推力必須由該層的樓板或周邊環梁以拉力平衡，否則節點會向外移動、整個網格失去形狀。對圓形或曲面平面的建築，例如聖瑪莉艾克斯 30 號的全三角化周邊結構，周邊環梁就像箍桶的鐵箍，承受環向拉力；樓板在這些樓層必須連續，不能被大開口切斷。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「樓板環向繫材」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: In a diagrid, gravity runs down inclined members; where two diagonals meet at a node their vertical components add and pass down, while their horizontal components push the node outwards. That outward thrust must be balanced in tension by the floor or perimeter ring beam at that level, otherwise the node moves out and the grid loses its shape. For circular or curved plans, such as the fully triangulated perimeter of 30 St Mary Axe, the perimeter ring works like a hoop on a barrel, carrying ring tension; floors at these levels must be continuous and not cut by large openings. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Floor hoop ties” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：節點外推力 H = P/(2·tanθ)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Node outward thrust H = P/(2·tanθ).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「斜交網格的樓板只承受樓面載重，與斜柱的穩定無關。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Floors in a diagrid only carry floor loads and have nothing to do with the diagonals' stability." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「樓板環向繫材」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Floor hoop ties”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.titleEn: Diagonal outward thrust and floor hoop tension

That outward thrust must be balanced in tension by the floor or perimeter ring beam at that level, otherwise the node moves out and the grid loses its shape.

knowledge.text: 誤解：斜交網格的樓板只承受樓面載重，與斜柱的穩定無關。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Floors in a diagrid only carry floor loads and have nothing to do with the diagonals' stability. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「斜柱外推力與樓板環向拉力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Diagonal outward thrust and floor hoop tension" is correct?
options: 斜交網格的樓板只承受樓面載重，與斜柱的穩定無關。
斜交網格的節點只要比構件強就好，細部不重要。
在斜交網格中，重力沿著傾斜的構件往下傳，兩根斜柱在節點相交時，垂直分量相加傳給下方，水平分量則把節點往外推。
optionsEn: Floors in a diagrid only carry floor loads and have nothing to do with the diagonals' stability.
Diagrid nodes only need to be stronger than the members; details do not matter.
In a diagrid, gravity runs down inclined members.
quiz.explanation: 在斜交網格中，重力沿著傾斜的構件往下傳，兩根斜柱在節點相交時，垂直分量相加傳給下方，水平分量則把節點往外推。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: In a diagrid, gravity runs down inclined members; where two diagonals meet at a node their vertical components add and pass down, while their horizontal components push the node outwards. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 斜柱外推力與樓板環向拉力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Diagonal outward thrust and floor hoop tension: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「樓板環向繫材」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Floor hoop ties” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：節點外推力 H = P/(2·tanθ)。節點重力 P = 10 MN、θ = 69°（tanθ ≈ 2.605），H ≈ 10/(2×2.605) ≈ 1.92 MN；圓形平面節點間距 s = 6 m 時，環向等效分布外推力 q = 1.92/6 ≈ 0.32 MN/m，半徑 R = 25 m 的環向拉力 T = q·R ≈ 8.0 MN。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Node outward thrust H = P/(2·tanθ). With a node gravity load P = 10 MN and θ = 69° (tanθ ≈ 2.605), H ≈ 10/(2×2.605) ≈ 1.92 MN; on a circular plan with nodes s = 6 m apart the equivalent radial load is q = 1.92/6 ≈ 0.32 MN/m, so a ring of radius R = 25 m carries hoop tension T = q·R ≈ 8.0 MN. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在結構模型中輸出每個節點樓層的環梁拉力與樓板面內應力，確認樓板與環梁連接能傳遞外推力；施工期間樓板尚未澆置時，以臨時繫材或先行的鋼環梁承擔外推力，並量測節點的水平位移是否在容許範圍內。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Output ring-beam tension and in-plane slab stresses at every node level from the structural model and confirm that slab-to-ring connections can transmit the thrust; during construction, before slabs are cast, carry the thrust with temporary ties or early steel ring beams and measure node horizontal movement against tolerance.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「斜柱外推力與樓板環向拉力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Diagonal outward thrust and floor hoop tension", which statement holds?
options: 節點外推力 H = P/(2·tanθ)。
斜柱是斜的，所以會自己靠在結構上，不需要臨時支撐。
有限元素分析已經夠精確，節點不需要做試驗。

Diagonals lean, so they rest against the structure on their own and need no temporary support.
Finite-element analysis is precise enough that nodes need no testing.

steps.title: 斜柱外推力與樓板環向拉力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Diagonal outward thrust and floor hoop tension: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「樓板環向繫材」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Floor hoop ties” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在結構模型中輸出每個節點樓層的環梁拉力與樓板面內應力，確認樓板與環梁連接能傳遞外推力；施工期間樓板尚未澆置時，以臨時繫材或先行的鋼環梁承擔外推力，並量測節點的水平位移是否在容許範圍內。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Output ring-beam tension and in-plane slab stresses at every node level from the structural model and confirm that slab-to-ring connections can transmit the thrust; during construction, before slabs are cast, carry the thrust with temporary ties or early steel ring beams and measure node horizontal movement against tolerance. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：在結構圖上標示所有承受環向拉力的樓層與環梁，並註明「此層樓板不得開設大開口」；臨時繫材的拆除順序列為施工停止點，須在樓板達到設計強度並經結構工程師確認後才可拆除。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Mark every floor and ring beam carrying hoop tension on the structural drawings with a note that no large openings may be cut in these slabs; make the removal sequence of temporary ties a construction hold point, allowed only after slabs reach design strength and the structural engineer confirms.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若節點樓層的樓板被挑空或大開口切斷，環向拉力無法連續傳遞，節點向外移位，斜柱與帷幕的幾何隨之變形；施工期間若在樓板完成前移除臨時繫材，節點可能在自重下外張。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If a node floor is cut by an atrium or large opening, hoop tension cannot pass continuously, the nodes move outwards and the geometry of diagonals and façade distorts; removing temporary ties before slabs are complete during construction can let nodes spread under self-weight. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在結構模型中輸出每個節點樓層的環梁拉力與樓板面內應力，確認樓板與環梁連接能傳遞外推力；施工期間樓板尚未澆置時，以臨時繫材或先行的鋼環梁承擔外推力，並量測節點的水平位移是否在容許範圍內。

steps.title: 斜柱外推力與樓板環向拉力：失效診斷

stages.description: 本階段聚焦「斜交網格節點的設計與製作」與「鋼管混凝土斜柱的勁度與耐火」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。

steps.title: 斜交網格節點的設計與製作：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Design and fabrication of diagrid nodes: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「螺栓與焊接節點」如何影響高層建築斜交網格結構的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Bolted and welded nodes” governs force, deformation or durability in “High-rise diagrid structures”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 節點是斜交網格中受力最集中、也最昂貴的部分：多根斜柱、環梁與樓板梁在同一點相交，每根構件的軸力方向不同，節點必須把它們平衡並傳給下一層。做法大致分為工廠焊接的鋼板節點、鑄鋼節點，以及工廠預製後在現場以高強度螺栓接合的節點；公開資料指出赫斯特大樓的斜柱在節點處以螺栓而非焊接連接，以加快高空施工並減少現場焊接的品質風險。螺栓節點的關鍵是摩擦面與預拉力，焊接節點的關鍵則是厚板焊接的韌性與殘留應力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「螺栓與焊接節點」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Nodes are where diagrid forces concentrate and where most of the cost lies: several diagonals, ring beams and floor beams meet at one point, each with axial force in a different direction, and the node must balance them and pass them to the next level. Approaches include shop-welded plate nodes, cast-steel nodes and shop-fabricated nodes joined on site with high-strength bolts; public sources note that the Hearst Tower diagonals are bolted rather than welded at the nodes, speeding erection at height and reducing the quality risk of site welding. For bolted nodes the keys are faying surfaces and pretension; for welded nodes, the toughness and residual stress of thick-plate welds. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Bolted and welded nodes” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：摩擦型螺栓抗滑 F_s = k_s·n·μ·F_p,C/γ。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Slip resistance of a preloaded bolt F_s = k_s·n·μ·F_p,C/γ.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「斜交網格的節點只要比構件強就好，細部不重要。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Diagrid nodes only need to be stronger than the members; details do not matter." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「螺栓與焊接節點」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Bolted and welded nodes”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 斜交網格節點的設計與製作：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Design and fabrication of diagrid nodes: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「螺栓與焊接節點」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Bolted and welded nodes” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：摩擦型螺栓抗滑 F_s = k_s·n·μ·F_p,C/γ。M30、10.9 級：F_p,C = 0.7×1,000×561 ≈ 392.7 kN；μ = 0.5、雙剪 n = 2、k_s = 1、γ = 1.25，F_s ≈ 1×2×0.5×392.7/1.25 ≈ 314 kN；斜柱軸力 12 MN 需 12,000/314 ≈ 38.2，取 40 支。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Slip resistance of a preloaded bolt F_s = k_s·n·μ·F_p,C/γ. For M30 grade 10.9, F_p,C = 0.7×1,000×561 ≈ 392.7 kN; with μ = 0.5, two slip planes n = 2, k_s = 1 and γ = 1.25, F_s ≈ 1×2×0.5×392.7/1.25 ≈ 314 kN, so a 12 MN diagonal force needs 12,000/314 ≈ 38.2, rounded up to 40 bolts. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：螺栓節點須確認摩擦面處理與抗滑係數試驗、螺栓預拉力（以扭矩或轉角法施工並抽驗）；焊接或鑄鋼節點則以有限元素分析求熱點應力，厚板焊接做超音波檢測，鑄鋼件做超音波與磁粒檢測並核對材料韌性。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: For bolted nodes confirm faying-surface preparation with slip-coefficient tests and bolt pretension, installed by torque or turn-of-nut and spot-checked; for welded or cast nodes obtain hot-spot stresses by finite-element analysis, ultrasonically test thick-plate welds, and test castings ultrasonically and by magnetic particle inspection while checking material toughness.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: Slip resistance of a preloaded bolt F_s = k_s·n·μ·F_p,C/γ. For M30 grade 10.9, F_p,C = 0.7×1,000×561 ≈ 392.7 kN; with μ = 0.5, two slip planes n = 2, k_s = 1 and γ = 1.25, F_s ≈ 1×2×0.5×392.7/1.25 ≈ 314 kN, so a 12 MN diagonal force needs 12,000/314 ≈ 38.2, rounded up to 40 bolts. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「斜交網格節點的設計與製作」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

quiz.explanation: 摩擦型螺栓抗滑 F_s = k_s·n·μ·F_p,C/γ。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Slip resistance of a preloaded bolt F_s = k_s·n·μ·F_p,C/γ. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 斜交網格節點的設計與製作：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Design and fabrication of diagrid nodes: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「螺栓與焊接節點」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Bolted and welded nodes” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 螺栓節點須確認摩擦面處理與抗滑係數試驗、螺栓預拉力（以扭矩或轉角法施工並抽驗）；焊接或鑄鋼節點則以有限元素分析求熱點應力，厚板焊接做超音波檢測，鑄鋼件做超音波與磁粒檢測並核對材料韌性。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: For bolted nodes confirm faying-surface preparation with slip-coefficient tests and bolt pretension, installed by torque or turn-of-nut and spot-checked; for welded or cast nodes obtain hot-spot stresses by finite-element analysis, ultrasonically test thick-plate welds, and test castings ultrasonically and by magnetic particle inspection while checking material toughness. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.instruction: 超高層斜交網格的斜柱軸力極大，廣州國際金融中心採用鋼管混凝土斜柱，直徑由底部約 1,800 mm 漸減到頂部約 900 mm，網格每 12 層形成高約 54 m 的菱形節點，並與核心筒組成筒中筒。管內混凝土大幅提高軸向勁度與受壓容量，並抑制鋼管向內挫屈；混凝土的熱容量也延緩鋼管升溫，但公開資料指出主要構材仍另外施作兩小時的防火被覆。斜放的鋼管讓混凝土澆置與排氣比垂直柱更困難。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「鋼管混凝土斜柱」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「鋼管混凝土斜柱」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Concrete-filled tube diagonals” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 斜管澆置前以足尺斜置模型試灌，切開檢查管頂與節點附近的空洞，確定澆置孔、排氣孔與自充填配比；正式施工以敲擊或超音波抽查，並記錄每段的澆置量與理論體積比對；防火被覆以厚度量測與附著試驗驗收。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before production, cast a full-scale inclined mock-up and cut it open to check voids along the crown and near nodes, fixing placement holes, vent holes and the self-consolidating mix; during construction spot-check by tapping or ultrasonic testing and compare each segment's placed volume with the theoretical volume; accept fire protection by thickness measurement and adhesion tests. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：斜管的澆置方向、排氣孔位置與澆置速度寫入施工計畫，每段設「模型試灌合格」與「前段檢測完成」兩個停止點；防火被覆的耐火時效依整體防火策略決定，不以填充混凝土替代，並由防火與結構工程師共同簽認。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Write placement direction, vent-hole positions and placement rate for inclined tubes into the construction plan, with two hold points per segment, mock-up approval and completion of checks on the previous segment; set fire-protection ratings from the overall fire strategy rather than relying on the fill, signed jointly by the fire and structural engineers.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：斜置鋼管的頂側容易積存空氣與泌水，形成長條狀空洞，該段的合成勁度與鋼管的挫屈約束都下降；若以為混凝土填充已足夠防火而省略被覆，火災中鋼管升溫失去強度，斜柱軸力轉移到相鄰構件。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Inclined tubes collect air and bleed water along the upper side, forming long voids that reduce composite stiffness and the restraint against tube buckling; omitting fire protection on the belief that the fill is enough lets the tube heat up and lose strength in a fire, shifting diagonal force to neighbouring members. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 鋼管混凝土斜柱的勁度與耐火：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Concrete-filled diagonals for stiffness and fire: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「鋼管混凝土斜柱」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Concrete-filled tube diagonals” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 斜置鋼管的頂側容易積存空氣與泌水，形成長條狀空洞，該段的合成勁度與鋼管的挫屈約束都下降；若以為混凝土填充已足夠防火而省略被覆，火災中鋼管升溫失去強度，斜柱軸力轉移到相鄰構件。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Inclined tubes collect air and bleed water along the upper side, forming long voids that reduce composite stiffness and the restraint against tube buckling; omitting fire protection on the belief that the fill is enough lets the tube heat up and lose strength in a fire, shifting diagonal force to neighbouring members. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Inclined tubes make concrete placement and venting harder than in vertical columns.

steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A tube filled with concrete needs no separate fire protection." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

quiz.question: 在「鋼管混凝土斜柱的勁度與耐火」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Concrete-filled diagonals for stiffness and fire" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
斜置鋼管的頂側容易積存空氣與泌水，形成長條狀空洞，該段的合成勁度與鋼管的挫屈約束都下降。

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「斜柱逐段安裝的穩定與臨時支撐」與「斜交網格的測量控制與誤差累積」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Stability and temporary support while erecting inclined members" and "Survey control and error accumulation in a diagrid": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 斜柱逐段安裝的穩定與臨時支撐：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Stability and temporary support while erecting inclined members: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「斜柱安裝的臨時支撐」如何影響高層建築斜交網格結構的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Temporary support of inclined members” governs force, deformation or durability in “High-rise diagrid structures”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 斜交網格只有在三角形閉合後才穩定；安裝過程中，一根剛吊上的斜柱只有下端接合，另一端懸空，自重就會讓它傾倒並在下端接合產生彎矩。施工時必須以臨時支撐、纜索或先行安裝的環梁把斜柱拉住，直到相鄰斜柱與環梁組成閉合三角形。安裝順序要讓每一個階段的未完成網格都是穩定的，並考慮施工期間的風力與吊裝碰撞。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「斜柱安裝的臨時支撐」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A diagrid is stable only once its triangles close; during erection a freshly lifted diagonal is joined only at its lower end with the other end free, and its own weight tends to tip it over, inducing moment in the lower connection. Temporary struts, cables or ring beams installed in advance must hold the diagonal until neighbouring diagonals and ring beams form a closed triangle. The erection sequence must keep every incomplete stage of the grid stable, allowing for construction wind and lifting impacts. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Temporary support of inclined members” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：單根斜柱的傾倒彎矩 M = W·(L/2)·cosθ。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Tipping moment of a single diagonal M = W·(L/2)·cosθ.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「斜柱是斜的，所以會自己靠在結構上，不需要臨時支撐。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Diagonals lean, so they rest against the structure on their own and need no temporary support." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「斜柱安裝的臨時支撐」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Temporary support of inclined members”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 誤解：斜柱是斜的，所以會自己靠在結構上，不需要臨時支撐。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「斜柱逐段安裝的穩定與臨時支撐」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Stability and temporary support while erecting inclined members" is correct?
options: 斜柱是斜的，所以會自己靠在結構上，不需要臨時支撐。
只要每根斜柱都在工廠做準，現場就不需要逐模組量測。

optionsEn: Diagonals lean, so they rest against the structure on their own and need no temporary support.

steps.title: 斜柱逐段安裝的穩定與臨時支撐：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Stability and temporary support while erecting inclined members: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「斜柱安裝的臨時支撐」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Temporary support of inclined members” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：單根斜柱的傾倒彎矩 M = W·(L/2)·cosθ。重 15 t（W ≈ 147 kN）、長 L = 17 m、θ = 69°：M ≈ 147×8.5×0.358 ≈ 448 kN·m；若以上端的臨時水平支撐抵抗，支撐力 R = M/(L·sinθ) ≈ 448/(17×0.934) ≈ 28 kN，另加施工風力與吊裝衝擊係數。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Tipping moment of a single diagonal M = W·(L/2)·cosθ. For a 15 t member (W ≈ 147 kN), L = 17 m and θ = 69°, M ≈ 147×8.5×0.358 ≈ 448 kN·m; resisted by a temporary horizontal brace at the top, the brace force is R = M/(L·sinθ) ≈ 448/(17×0.934) ≈ 28 kN, plus construction wind and a lifting-impact factor. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以施工階段分析檢查每個安裝步驟中未完成網格的穩定性與臨時支撐受力，臨時支撐與其錨定點須有計算書；每根斜柱就位後量測上端座標，確認在容許偏差內才可鬆鉤，閉合三角形後才可拆除臨時支撐。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check the stability of the incomplete grid and the temporary-support forces at every erection step with a construction-stage analysis, backed by calculations for each support and its anchorage; measure the top coordinates of every diagonal after placement and release the hook only when within tolerance, removing temporary supports only after the triangle closes.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 單根斜柱的傾倒彎矩 M = W·(L/2)·cosθ。重 15 t（W ≈ 147 kN）、長 L = 17 m、θ = 69°：M ≈ 147×8.5×0.358 ≈ 448 kN·m；若以上端的臨時水平支撐抵抗，支撐力 R = M/(L·sinθ) ≈ 448/(17×0.934) ≈ 28 kN，另加施工風力與吊裝衝擊係數。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Tipping moment of a single diagonal M = W·(L/2)·cosθ. For a 15 t member (W ≈ 147 kN), L = 17 m and θ = 69°, M ≈ 147×8.5×0.358 ≈ 448 kN·m; resisted by a temporary horizontal brace at the top, the brace force is R = M/(L·sinθ) ≈ 448/(17×0.934) ≈ 28 kN, plus construction wind and a lifting-impact factor. knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「斜柱逐段安裝的穩定與臨時支撐」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

steps.title: 斜交網格的測量控制與誤差累積：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Survey control and error accumulation in a diagrid: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「節點座標與累積誤差」如何影響高層建築斜交網格結構的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Node coordinates and accumulated error” governs force, deformation or durability in “High-rise diagrid structures”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 斜交網格的幾何由節點座標決定，帷幕單元、樓板邊緣與環梁長度都依節點位置預先製造；一旦節點位置偏差累積，上方的斜柱長度與角度就無法吻合。與垂直柱不同，斜柱的長度誤差會同時造成水平與垂直偏移，而且相鄰節點的偏差會互相牽動。測量控制必須分辨隨機誤差（各節點獨立）與系統誤差（如測量基準偏移、溫度或焊接收縮造成的同方向偏差），後者會線性累積，是最危險的。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「節點座標與累積誤差」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A diagrid's geometry is set by its node coordinates, and façade units, slab edges and ring-beam lengths are fabricated in advance from those positions; once node deviations accumulate, the lengths and angles of diagonals above no longer fit. Unlike vertical columns, a length error in a diagonal produces both horizontal and vertical offsets, and deviations at adjacent nodes interact. Survey control must distinguish random errors, independent at each node, from systematic errors, such as datum drift or same-direction offsets from temperature or weld shrinkage; the latter accumulate linearly and are the most dangerous. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Node coordinates and accumulated error” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：誤差累積：每一模組節點的隨機誤差 σ = 3 mm、共 8 個模組時，總誤差約 3×√8 ≈ 8.5 mm；若同樣 3 mm 是系統性偏差，總誤差為 3×8 = 24 mm，接近三倍。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Error accumulation: with a random node error σ = 3 mm per module over 8 modules, the total is about 3×√8 ≈ 8.5 mm; if the same 3 mm is systematic, the total is 3×8 = 24 mm, nearly three times as much.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要每根斜柱都在工廠做準，現場就不需要逐模組量測。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If every diagonal is made accurately in the shop, no module-by-module survey is needed on site." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.

steps.title: 斜交網格的測量控制與誤差累積：定量估算

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：誤差累積：每一模組節點的隨機誤差 σ = 3 mm、共 8 個模組時，總誤差約 3×√8 ≈ 8.5 mm；若同樣 3 mm 是系統性偏差，總誤差為 3×8 = 24 mm，接近三倍。因此每一模組都要回到固定基準重新定位，而不是以前一層為基準往上累加。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Error accumulation: with a random node error σ = 3 mm per module over 8 modules, the total is about 3×√8 ≈ 8.5 mm; if the same 3 mm is systematic, the total is 3×8 = 24 mm, nearly three times as much. Every module must therefore be set out again from fixed datums rather than built up from the level below. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：建立獨立於結構的控制網，每一模組完成後以全測站量測所有節點座標，並在溫度均勻的時段量測；把實測座標與考慮自重、溫度與焊接收縮的預測座標比較，偏差趨勢呈同方向時立即檢討原因並調整上方構件的製造尺寸。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Establish a control network independent of the structure, survey every node with a total station after each module in thermally uniform conditions, and compare measured coordinates with those predicted including self-weight, temperature and weld shrinkage; when deviations trend in one direction, investigate at once and adjust the fabrication dimensions of members above.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。

options: 防火塗料塗一次就能永久有效，不需要檢查。
誤差累積：每一模組節點的隨機誤差 σ = 3 mm、共 8 個模組時，總誤差約 3×√8 ≈ 8.5 mm。
斜交網格的角度只是建築造型的選擇，對結構效率沒有影響。
optionsEn: A fire coating, once applied, lasts for ever and needs no inspection.
Error accumulation: with a random node error σ = 3 mm per module over 8 modules, the total is about 3×√8 ≈ 8.5 mm.
The diagrid angle is purely an aesthetic choice with no effect on structural efficiency.
quiz.explanation: 誤差累積：每一模組節點的隨機誤差 σ = 3 mm、共 8 個模組時，總誤差約 3×√8 ≈ 8.5 mm；若同樣 3 mm 是系統性偏差，總誤差為 3×8 = 24 mm，接近三倍。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Error accumulation: with a random node error σ = 3 mm per module over 8 modules, the total is about 3×√8 ≈ 8.5 mm; if the same 3 mm is systematic, the total is 3×8 = 24 mm, nearly three times as much. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 斜交網格的測量控制與誤差累積：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Survey control and error accumulation in a diagrid: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「節點座標與累積誤差」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Node coordinates and accumulated error” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 建立獨立於結構的控制網，每一模組完成後以全測站量測所有節點座標，並在溫度均勻的時段量測；把實測座標與考慮自重、溫度與焊接收縮的預測座標比較，偏差趨勢呈同方向時立即檢討原因並調整上方構件的製造尺寸。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Establish a control network independent of the structure, survey every node with a total station after each module in thermally uniform conditions, and compare measured coordinates with those predicted including self-weight, temperature and weld shrinkage; when deviations trend in one direction, investigate at once and adjust the fabrication dimensions of members above. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：測量計畫規定固定基準點、量測時段、各模組的容許偏差與趨勢判斷規則；量測結果即時回饋給鋼構製造廠與帷幕廠，作為後續構件尺寸調整的依據，修正量由結構工程師核可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The survey plan fixes datum points, measurement windows, module tolerances and trend rules; feed results back immediately to the steel fabricator and façade supplier as the basis for adjusting later member sizes, with corrections approved by the structural engineer.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若每層都以下層節點為基準往上放樣，系統誤差會一路累積，到上部時預製的帷幕單元與斜柱無法安裝，只能現場修改或重新製造；節點間距誤差也會使環梁拉力分布不均。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Setting out each level from the nodes below lets systematic error accumulate upwards until prefabricated façade units and diagonals no longer fit, forcing site modification or refabrication; errors in node spacing also make ring-beam tension uneven. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 斜交網格的測量控制與誤差累積：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Survey control and error accumulation in a diagrid: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「節點座標與累積誤差」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Node coordinates and accumulated error” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若每層都以下層節點為基準往上放樣，系統誤差會一路累積，到上部時預製的帷幕單元與斜柱無法安裝，只能現場修改或重新製造；節點間距誤差也會使環梁拉力分布不均。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Setting out each level from the nodes below lets systematic error accumulate upwards until prefabricated façade units and diagonals no longer fit, forcing site modification or refabrication; errors in node spacing also make ring-beam tension uneven. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：測量控制必須分辨隨機誤差（各節點獨立）與系統誤差（如測量基準偏移、溫度或焊接收縮造成的同方向偏差），後者會線性累積，是最危險的。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Survey control must distinguish random errors, independent at each node, from systematic errors, such as datum drift or same-direction offsets from temperature or weld shrinkage; the latter accumulate linearly and are the most dangerous.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要每根斜柱都在工廠做準，現場就不需要逐模組量測。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If every diagonal is made accurately in the shop, no module-by-module survey is needed on site." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「節點原型試驗與應力集中驗證」與「以環境振動驗證斜交網格的勁度」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Node prototype tests and stress-concentration checks" and "Verifying diagrid stiffness from ambient vibration": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 節點原型試驗與應力集中驗證：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Node prototype tests and stress-concentration checks: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「節點足尺試驗」如何影響高層建築斜交網格結構的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Full-scale node tests” governs force, deformation or durability in “High-rise diagrid structures”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 斜交網格節點的幾何複雜，多向受力下的應力集中與塑性發展很難只靠計算確定，因此重要專案常以足尺或大比例原型試驗驗證。試驗以多支油壓千斤頂模擬各斜柱的軸力比例，在設計載重的倍數下量測熱點應變、變形與破壞模式，確認節點強度高於相連構件，並驗證有限元素模型的應力集中係數。試驗結果也用來決定生產節點的檢驗重點。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「節點足尺試驗」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Diagrid nodes are geometrically complex, and stress concentration and plastic development under multi-directional loads are hard to establish by calculation alone, so major projects often verify them with full-scale or large-scale prototype tests. Several hydraulic jacks reproduce the proportions of the diagonal forces, and hot-spot strains, deformations and failure modes are measured at multiples of the design load to confirm that the node is stronger than the connected members and to validate the stress concentration factors of the finite-element model. The results also set the inspection focus for production nodes. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Full-scale node tests” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：應力集中係數 SCF = σ_熱點/σ_名目。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Stress concentration factor SCF = σ_hot/σ_nominal.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「有限元素分析已經夠精確，節點不需要做試驗。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Finite-element analysis is precise enough that nodes need no testing." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「節點足尺試驗」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Full-scale node tests”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 節點原型試驗與應力集中驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Node prototype tests and stress-concentration checks: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「節點足尺試驗」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Full-scale node tests” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：應力集中係數 SCF = σ_熱點/σ_名目。原型在 1.5 倍設計載重下名目應力 200 MPa、熱點量得 480 MPa（尚在彈性範圍），SCF = 480/200 = 2.4；有限元素預測 2.3，差約 4%，可接受。若量得 SCF 3.0，熱點處的疲勞壽命以應力三次方估計將降為約 (2.4/3.0)³ ≈ 51%。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Stress concentration factor SCF = σ_hot/σ_nominal. At 1.5 times design load a prototype with 200 MPa nominal stress shows 480 MPa at the hot spot, still elastic, so SCF = 480/200 = 2.4; the finite-element prediction of 2.3 is within about 4%, which is acceptable. Had the SCF been 3.0, fatigue life at the hot spot, scaling with stress cubed, would fall to about (2.4/3.0)³ ≈ 51%. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：試驗計畫先由設計者、試驗室與第三方審查，規定載重比例、加載步驟、應變計位置與停止條件；試驗後比較實測與預測的應變分布、剛度與破壞位置，並將差異納入生產節點的檢驗重點與焊接要求。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Have the designer, laboratory and a third party review the test plan beforehand, fixing load ratios, loading steps, strain-gauge locations and stop criteria; afterwards compare measured and predicted strain distributions, stiffness and failure location, and carry any differences into the inspection focus and welding requirements for production nodes.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 應力集中係數 SCF = σ_熱點/σ_名目。原型在 1.5 倍設計載重下名目應力 200 MPa、熱點量得 480 MPa（尚在彈性範圍），SCF = 480/200 = 2.4；有限元素預測 2.3，差約 4%，可接受。若量得 SCF 3.0，熱點處的疲勞壽命以應力三次方估計將降為約 (2.4/3.0)³ ≈ 51%。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Stress concentration factor SCF = σ_hot/σ_nominal. At 1.5 times design load a prototype with 200 MPa nominal stress shows 480 MPa at the hot spot, still elastic, so SCF = 480/200 = 2.4; the finite-element prediction of 2.3 is within about 4%, which is acceptable. Had the SCF been 3.0, fatigue life at the hot spot, scaling with stress cubed, would fall to about (2.4/3.0)³ ≈ 51%. Values are teaching assumptions.

steps.title: 以環境振動驗證斜交網格的勁度：機制與傳力路徑

steps.objective: 說明「實測週期與勁度驗證」如何影響高層建築斜交網格結構的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Measured period and stiffness check” governs force, deformation or durability in “High-rise diagrid structures”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 斜交網格的側向勁度主要來自斜柱的軸向勁度與節點的實際剛度，模型中節點偏心、螺栓滑動、樓板參與與非結構構件都會影響結果。完工後以環境振動量測建築的前幾個模態週期，是驗證整體勁度最直接的方法：週期比預測短代表實際較勁，可能是帷幕與隔間參與；週期比預測長則可能是節點或接合比假設柔。量測結果用來校正模型，作為日後評估改裝與事件後狀態的基準。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「實測週期與勁度驗證」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A diagrid's lateral stiffness comes mainly from the diagonals' axial stiffness and the actual rigidity of the nodes, and node eccentricity, bolt slip, slab participation and non-structural elements all affect the model result. Measuring the first few modal periods by ambient vibration after completion is the most direct check of overall stiffness: a period shorter than predicted means the building is stiffer, perhaps with façade and partitions participating, while a longer period may mean nodes or joints are softer than assumed. The measurements calibrate the model as a baseline for later assessment of alterations and post-event condition. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Measured period and stiffness check” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 以環境振動驗證斜交網格的勁度：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「實測週期與勁度驗證」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Measured period and stiffness check” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：由 T = 2π√(m/k) 得 k ∝ 1/T²。若預測週期 4.4 s、實測 4.0 s，實際勁度約為預測的 (4.4/4.0)² ≈ 1.21 倍；若實測 4.8 s，則只有 (4.4/4.8)² ≈ 0.84 倍，代表節點或接合可能比模型柔，須進一步檢查。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: From T = 2π√(m/k), k ∝ 1/T². Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在頂層與中間樓層兩個方向及角落設置加速度計，長時間記錄並以兩種識別方法求週期與振型；先確認質量假設（實際裝修與設備重量），再以勁度修正模型使週期吻合，並檢查修正後的變位與構件力是否仍符合要求。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Install accelerometers in both directions and at corners on the top and intermediate floors, record for long periods and identify periods and mode shapes by two methods; first confirm the mass assumptions, including actual fit-out and equipment, then adjust stiffness so the model matches the periods, and check that drifts and member forces still comply after updating.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.

knowledge.text: 由 T = 2π√(m/k) 得 k ∝ 1/T²。若預測週期 4.4 s、實測 4.0 s，實際勁度約為預測的 (4.4/4.0)² ≈ 1.21 倍；若實測 4.8 s，則只有 (4.4/4.8)² ≈ 0.84 倍，代表節點或接合可能比模型柔，須進一步檢查。數值為教學假設。

If the predicted period is 4.4 s and the measured one 4.0 s, actual stiffness is about (4.4/4.0)² ≈ 1.21 times the prediction; a measured 4.8 s gives only (4.4/4.8)² ≈ 0.84 times, suggesting nodes or joints softer than modelled and calling for further checks. steps.title: 以環境振動驗證斜交網格的勁度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Verifying diagrid stiffness from ambient vibration: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「實測週期與勁度驗證」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Measured period and stiffness check” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在頂層與中間樓層兩個方向及角落設置加速度計，長時間記錄並以兩種識別方法求週期與振型；先確認質量假設（實際裝修與設備重量），再以勁度修正模型使週期吻合，並檢查修正後的變位與構件力是否仍符合要求。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Install accelerometers in both directions and at corners on the top and intermediate floors, record for long periods and identify periods and mode shapes by two methods; first confirm the mass assumptions, including actual fit-out and equipment, then adjust stiffness so the model matches the periods, and check that drifts and member forces still comply after updating. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把完工後的環境振動量測列入驗收項目，報告附原始資料、識別方法與校正後的模型參數；大規模改裝前後各量測一次，以確認勁度變化是否在可接受範圍。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Make post-completion ambient vibration measurement an acceptance item, with raw data, identification methods and calibrated model parameters in the report; measure again before and after any major refit to confirm that stiffness changes are acceptable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若量得週期明顯偏長卻未追查，可能隱藏節點螺栓未達預拉力或接合滑動的問題，在強風中逐漸惡化；若把偏短的週期全部歸功於結構而忽略非結構構件，改裝拆除隔間後勁度會下降，舒適度變差。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Ignoring a markedly longer measured period can hide nodes with under-tensioned bolts or slipping joints that worsen in strong winds; crediting a shorter period entirely to the structure and ignoring non-structural elements means stiffness drops when partitions are removed in a refit, worsening comfort. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「實測週期與勁度驗證」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。

steps.title: 外露斜柱的耐火與防蝕維護：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Fire protection and corrosion upkeep of exposed diagonals: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「外露斜柱耐火被覆」如何影響高層建築斜交網格結構的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Fire protection of exposed diagonals” governs force, deformation or durability in “High-rise diagrid structures”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 斜交網格的斜柱常是建築造型的一部分，在室內或帷幕後方外露，業主希望看得到鋼構，因此多採用薄層膨脹型防火塗料而非厚重的噴覆。斜柱一旦在火災中失去強度，傳力路徑會重新分配，但每根斜柱都同時承擔重力與側力，冗餘度有限；防火被覆的厚度要依構件的斷面係數決定，斷面越厚實，需要的塗層越薄。靠近帷幕的斜柱還可能受到冷凝水與溫度變化影響，塗層的完整性需要長期維護。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「外露斜柱耐火被覆」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Diagrid diagonals are often part of the architecture, exposed inside or behind the glazing, and owners want the steel visible, so thin intumescent coatings are favoured over heavy sprayed protection. If a diagonal loses strength in a fire the load path redistributes, but each diagonal carries both gravity and lateral load, so redundancy is limited; coating thickness is set by the member's section factor, with stockier sections needing thinner coatings. Diagonals next to the façade may also see condensation and temperature swings, so coating integrity needs long-term upkeep. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Fire protection of exposed diagonals” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：斷面係數 H_p/A = 受熱周長/斷面積。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Section factor H_p/A = heated perimeter over cross-sectional area.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「防火塗料塗一次就能永久有效，不需要檢查。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A fire coating, once applied, lasts for ever and needs no inspection." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.

steps.title: 外露斜柱的耐火與防蝕維護：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Fire protection and corrosion upkeep of exposed diagonals: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「外露斜柱耐火被覆」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Fire protection of exposed diagonals” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：斷面係數 H_p/A = 受熱周長/斷面積。600 mm 方管、厚 40 mm：A = 0.6² − 0.52² ≈ 0.0896 m²、H_p = 2.4 m，H_p/A ≈ 26.8 m⁻¹，屬於厚實斷面，所需膨脹塗層較薄；若改為 H_p/A ≈ 150 m⁻¹ 的薄壁構件，同樣耐火時效需要的塗層會厚得多。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Section factor H_p/A = heated perimeter over cross-sectional area. A 600 mm square box with 40 mm walls has A = 0.6² − 0.52² ≈ 0.0896 m² and H_p = 2.4 m, so H_p/A ≈ 26.8 m⁻¹, a stocky section needing a relatively thin intumescent coat; a thin-walled member with H_p/A ≈ 150 m⁻¹ would need a much thicker coat for the same fire rating. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：防火塗料的厚度依經認證的厚度表與實際斷面係數決定，施工後以乾膜厚度計逐構件量測並記錄；營運中定期目視檢查塗層破損、剝離與鏽斑，帷幕附近加強檢查冷凝區域，任何碰撞損傷都要依原規格修補並重新量測。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Set fire-coating thickness from certified loading tables and the actual section factor, and after application measure dry-film thickness member by member and record it; in service inspect periodically for coating damage, delamination and rust spots, giving extra attention to condensation zones near the façade, and repair any impact damage to the original specification with re-measurement.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。

steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Reinforcement for hoop tension A_s = T/(φ·f_y). With T = 8.0 MN, φ = 0.9 and f_y = 420 MPa, A_s ≈ 8.0×10⁶/(0.9×420) ≈ 21,160 mm²; if a refit opening cuts 40% of the slab tie bars, a supplementary steel ring beam or added bars must restore about 0.4×21,160 ≈ 8,470 mm² of tension area. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：改裝申請須附結構圖套繪，標出受影響的樓板繫筋、環梁與斜柱；以掃描或鋼筋探測確認開口位置的鋼筋配置，補強完成後由結構工程師現場驗收，並更新竣工圖與結構管制圖。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Alteration requests must overlay the structural drawings, marking affected slab ties, ring beams and diagonals; confirm the reinforcement at the proposed opening by scanning or cover-meter survey, have the structural engineer accept the strengthening on site and update the as-built and structural control drawings.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 租戶改裝與斜交網格的交接管控：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Tenant refits and handover controls for a diagrid: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「改裝時的斜柱與樓板保護」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Protecting diagonals and slabs in refits” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 改裝申請須附結構圖套繪，標出受影響的樓板繫筋、環梁與斜柱；以掃描或鋼筋探測確認開口位置的鋼筋配置，補強完成後由結構工程師現場驗收，並更新竣工圖與結構管制圖。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Alteration requests must overlay the structural drawings, marking affected slab ties, ring beams and diagonals; confirm the reinforcement at the proposed opening by scanning or cover-meter survey, have the structural engineer accept the strengthening on site and update the as-built and structural control drawings. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接文件包含斜交網格系統圖、節點樓層與環梁清單、禁止開孔區域圖與改裝審查流程；租約中明定結構管制條款，任何涉及斜柱、環梁或節點樓層的工程須經結構工程師簽認後才可施作。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Handover documents include the diagrid system drawing, lists of node floors and ring beams, no-opening zone plans and the alteration review procedure; leases state the structural control clauses, and any work touching diagonals, ring beams or node floors proceeds only after the structural engineer signs off.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：未經審查在節點樓層開設挑空，環向拉力傳遞中斷，節點緩慢外移並造成帷幕接縫開裂；在斜柱上焊接夾層支架則可能造成熱影響區脆化與防火塗層破損，形成難以察覺的隱患。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Cutting an atrium on a node floor without review interrupts hoop tension, letting nodes creep outwards and crack façade joints; welding mezzanine brackets to diagonals can embrittle the heat-affected zone and damage the fire coating, creating hidden hazards. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 租戶改裝與斜交網格的交接管控：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Tenant refits and handover controls for a diagrid: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「改裝時的斜柱與樓板保護」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Protecting diagonals and slabs in refits” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 未經審查在節點樓層開設挑空，環向拉力傳遞中斷，節點緩慢外移並造成帷幕接縫開裂；在斜柱上焊接夾層支架則可能造成熱影響區脆化與防火塗層破損，形成難以察覺的隱患。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Cutting an atrium on a node floor without review interrupts hoop tension, letting nodes creep outwards and crack façade joints; welding mezzanine brackets to diagonals can embrittle the heat-affected zone and damage the fire coating, creating hidden hazards. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：交接時必須把「哪些構件與樓板是網格系統的一部分」清楚告訴營運單位，並建立改裝審查流程；帷幕更換或外牆清洗設備的固定點若設在斜柱上，也要經結構確認。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Handover must make clear to the operator which members and slabs belong to the grid system and establish an alteration review process; fixings for façade replacement or cleaning equipment attached to diagonals also need structural confirmation.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「斜交網格的樓板只是一般樓板，租戶可以自由開孔。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Diagrid floors are ordinary slabs that tenants may cut freely." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「租戶改裝與斜交網格的交接管控」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Tenant refits and handover controls for a diagrid" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
未經審查在節點樓層開設挑空，環向拉力傳遞中斷，節點緩慢外移並造成帷幕接縫開裂；在斜柱上焊接夾層支架則可能造成熱影響區脆化與防火塗層破損，形成難以察覺的隱患。
